title: Space Physics: The Solar System and Beyond

flashcard_questions.q: The Sun and all the objects that orbit it, including eight planets, dwarf planets, moons, asteroids and comets.
A medium-sized star in the stable phase of its life cycle, fusing hydrogen into helium in its core.
The force of attraction between any two objects with mass. It holds planets in orbit around the Sun.

flashcard_questions.a: An object that orbits a planet or star. Natural satellites include moons; artificial satellites are human-made objects such as the International Space Station.
An orbit where a satellite takes exactly 24 hours to complete one revolution, so it stays above the same point on Earth's surface.
